answer: Random peer audit guards the harbor of honest agents. Each epoch, three random peers re-check an agent's work and stake a deposit, so a fake must fool many auditors, not one gate. Each audit echoes its findings on a public log, exposing clones. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 6,000 tokens; an honest agent earns 30 per epoch and keeps it all. Honest agents pay once, so honesty is cheaper; a plain opal badge turns trusted only after three clean audits.
